provenance.author: Devin using GLM-5.2
provenance.content_origin: Environment-generated seeded calendars; Devin selected and described probe actions
provenance.method: Seeds were selected by running CalendarEnv.reset(seed) and checking specific slots against the environment's own verifier. Each probe's claim (valid_slot, invalid_slot) was confirmed by the verifier before committing. No probe depends on a frontier model output.
provenance.note: These probes exercise the verifier and harness only. They are not training labels, not held-out evaluation data, and not a frontier model's output. They exist to prove the environment correctly accepts valid slots and rejects invalid ones.

probes.description: Seed 0: a 120-minute meeting at tue 12:00 fits business hours and avoids the shared tue 10:30-12:00 block. Slot is valid.
Seed 7: a 90-minute meeting at thu 09:00 fits business hours and avoids all shared blocks and attendee unavailability. Slot is valid.
Seed 0: a 120-minute meeting at tue 09:00 overlaps the shared tue 10:30-12:00 block. Slot is invalid.
Seed 7: a 90-minute meeting at thu 13:00 overlaps alice's thu 14:00-16:00 unavailability. Slot is invalid.
Seed 0: business hours start at 09:00. A meeting at tue 08:00 starts too early. Slot is invalid.
Seed 7 date range is thu, fri. wed is outside the date range. Slot is invalid.
Seed 3 has no 120-minute slot satisfying all shared blocks and attendee unavailability, so NONE is correct.
